versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "mass-production-quality-gate" skill for production phase quality control and escalation.

- Provides standardized escalation and containment action cards based on exception severity and escalation thresholds.
- Generates a trackable quality escalation board (.txt + .md) for follow-up and closure tracking.
- Targets production quality managers, SQEs, and line quality engineers handling in-field exceptions, complaints, or batch issues.
- Focuses strictly on mass production, not replacing NPI Quality Gate or Safe Launch processes.
- Delivers actionable recommendations, avoids theoretical principles, and distinguishes roles and boundaries clearly.
